title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.

  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget

  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year

  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Engenheiro de Software Full Stack SR
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Golang Developer - Relocation to Spain
description:
At CAPITOLE, we keep growing and want to do it with you!


We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.


The position is fully remote, but you must be based in Spain, with willingness to relocate to Barcelona or Madrid. We take care of processing the highly qualified work permit.


What profile are we looking for?

  • University degree or, equivalently, 5 years of professional experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in backend development with Golang and a minimum of 2 years of experience in PHP/Symfony, Java/Kotlin or Python.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.


The position is fully remote, but you must be based in Spain, with willingness to relocate to Barcelona or Madrid. We take care of processing the highly qualified work permit.


What profile are we looking for?

  • University degree or, equivalently, 5 years of professional experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in backend development with Golang and a minimum of 2 years of experience in PHP/Symfony, Java/Kotlin or Python.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Why Luxoft?


Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Our benefits:

  • Comprehensive health & dental insurance (Amil, fully paid, incl. dependents)
  • Remote / home office allowance (monthly)
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation voucher
  • Childcare / family allowance
  • Savings plan (FGTS)
  • Life & mandatory insurance (fully covered)
  • Profit sharing program


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:


- Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements

- Resolve Calypso environment related issues

- Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes

- Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance

- Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements

- Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements

- Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored

- Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)

- Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees

- Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work

- Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills:

• 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso

• Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso

• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects

• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects

- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

• Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management

• Leadership skills

• Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.

• Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills

• Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills:

• Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.

• Have a willingness to learn new skills

• Must have attention to detail

• Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


• Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)

• Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )

• Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Spanish: C2 Proficient


Luxoft is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

We show fairness to all throughout our talent acquisition and management process.

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior
description:
Somos a Ōner Travel , uma solução completa do ecossistema BeFly para agentes que desejam ter uma plataforma online de vendas. Temos um time apaixonado por viagens e tecnologia, além da solução inteligente, responsável por unir essas duas paixões em uma experiência única, fácil e eficiente.


O que nos move é certeza de que juntos criamos caminhos além do imaginável.

Venha com a gente!


Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior, com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que tenha base sólida na nossa stack atual (C#, .NET e Angular), mas também repertório em outras tecnologias como Node.js e React, para nos ajudar a evoluir, modernizar e repensar partes do sistema.


É uma posição hands-on, mas com espaço real para influenciar decisões técnicas, apoiar o time e ajudar a desenhar os próximos passos da plataforma.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir produtos e códigos já existentes;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time, apoiando na padronização de boas práticas;
  • Mapear, propor e apoiar a reestruturação de arquitetura;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Contribuir para decisões de inovação e definição tecnológica junto ao Tech Lead e demais desenvolvedores;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.


Requisitos técnicos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) full stack (mínimo de 5 anos);
  • Forte conhecimento em C#, .NET e SQL Server;
  • Experiência com Angular e React no front-end;
  • Vivência com Node.js no backend;• Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas (DDD, desacoplamento, escalabilidade);
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria e comunicação assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka etc.) em arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e WebServices;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Vivência com AWS;
  • Familiaridade com Azure Boards ou ferramentas similares de gestão ágil.


Perfil comportamental


Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

Uma pessoa que goste de desafios, tenha curiosidade técnica, vontade de aprender e que não se limite apenas a executar — mas que também pense, questione e ajude a construir soluções melhores junto com o time!


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR Ifood benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Revenue Ops para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

  • Acompanhar indicadores de geração de demanda, produtividade e eficiência comercial, identificando gargalos e oportunidades

  • Participar da definição e monitoramento de metas e comissões
  • Conectar dados de diferentes fontes e gerar insights acionáveis sobre produtividade, canais, perfil de cliente, jornada de compra e receita

description:
Código da vaga:57766


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:


Bons conhecimentos em peças de CRM, mídia e social - campanhas digitais.

Pacote Office;

Excelente conhecimento da língua portuguesa;

Criação de textos para banners, e-mails e sites;

Roteiros simples e mini vídeos;

Bom senso estético;


  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Buscamos um fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Bons conhecimentos em peças de CRM, mídia e social - campanhas digitais.

Pacote Office;

Excelente conhecimento da língua portuguesa;

Criação de textos para banners, e-mails e sites;

Roteiros simples e mini vídeos;

Bom senso estético;

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Support & Implementation)
description:
The Role


We are Appointwise. We build high-end AI infrastructure that replaces manual sales teams with autonomous digital workforces. We recently launched Appointwise 2.0 , a visual, node-based platform that allows businesses to architect complex behavior, not just simple chatbots.


We are looking for a Solutions Engineer . This is not a standard customer support role where you read from a script. You are the technical architect for our clients. You will be debugging complex logic flows, building agents live on Zoom to demonstrate capabilities, and solving implementation blockers instantly.


What You Will Do


  • Enterprise & Standard Support: You will manage support across all client tiers. This includes handling complex custom implementations for Enterprise clients while providing efficient, day-to-day troubleshooting for standard users.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: You will diagnose and resolve logic errors, infinite loops, and variable configuration issues within our node-based builder by using back-end logs/systems.
  • Live Implementation: You will join calls with enterprise clients to build and configure custom workflows in real-time, ensuring their agents are set up correctly for deployment.
  • Video-First Resolution: You will manage support tickets with a focus on clarity. Instead of long text replies, you will frequently record Loom videos to visually explain fixes and guide users through the solution.
  • Product Improvement: You will identify recurring bugs and user friction points, reporting them to the engineering team to help prioritize platform updates.


Who We Are Looking For


  • You are an Automation Native: You have deep experience with visual logic builders (Make, n8n, Voiceflow, or GoHighLevel Workflows). You understand JSON, Webhooks, and API payloads.
  • You Explain Complexity Simply: You can explain technical concepts (like how a variable passes data between nodes) to a non-technical business owner without jargon.
  • You are Presentable & Sharp: You are comfortable on camera. You have a professional setup, clear audio, and the ability to think on your feet during live demos.
  • You are \"Inbox Zero\" Obsessed: You hate leaving problems unsolved. You are proactive, fast, and thorough.


Requirements


  • Proven experience building complex automations (Portfolio or examples required).
  • Deep understanding of LLMs (Prompt engineering, Context windows, System prompts).
  • Excellent written and verbal English (Native or C2 level).
  • Been in a previous customer facing technical support roles
  • Ability to work US/EST hours.


How to Apply


We do not just want a cover letter.


  • Record a short Loom video (max 3 minutes).
  • Tell us about the most complex automation you have ever built and your previous support roles.
  • Explain how it worked and why you built it.
  • Send the link along with your CV/Resume.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

title: System Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • - Server Hardware Management
  • - Virtualization, especially VMware
  • - Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • - Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • - Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.


Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.


Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant
description:
EBAS Group is a tech first and high-trust talent consultancy partnering with some of the fastest growing, VC-backed US SaaS startups backed by the likes of Sequoia Capital, Google Ventures and a16z. We are rapidly expanding into the US and hiring a senior, delivery-focused recruiter to support increasing US client demand.


Why this role


  • Huge earnings potential: Strong bonus scheme and high placement fees with guaranteed role flow.
  • Own meaningful outcomes: Run high-impact searches end-to-end, with real autonomy and focus (no business development required)
  • High-growth client exposure: Lead searches for some of the fastest-growing US SaaS companies, often as the exclusive or minimum the primary recruiter.
  • Earn more when you deliver more: Uncapped accelerators that materially increase upside for top performance.
  • More time on recruiting, less time on admin: A custom-built GPT plus dedicated offshore support to take work off your plate so you can fill more roles.


Why EBAS


  • A high-trust place to do your best work: Founder-led, non-hierarchical environment with autonomy and ownership baked in.
  • Modern recruiting toolkit: Strong investment in AI, tooling, and enablement to help you move faster and operate at a higher level.
  • Quality over quotas: A quality-first culture focused on outcomes and long-term relationships—not transactional KPIs.


What you will do


  • Own end-to-end recruitment for US-based SaaS sales roles
  • Run client briefs, challenge assumptions and advise founders
  • Source and close senior candidates in competitive markets
  • Manage interviews, offers and candidate experience
  • Build long-term talent pools and trusted client relationships


What we are looking for


  • MUST have 3+ years agency recruitment experience (not the same as talent acquisition)
  • Strong history of exceeding targets and ideally a consistent top biller at their agency
  • Strong background recruiting SaaS or technology sales roles for startups
  • Exposure to US clients or markets preferred
  • Consultative, quality-driven and confident pushing back
  • Autonomous, coachable and outcome-focused
  • Based in Brazil and comfortable working US hours

  • Strong background recruiting SaaS or technology sales roles for startups

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Data Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.


Responsibilities

  • Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
  • Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
  • Write and optimize SQL in MySQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
  • Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
  • Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
  • Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, MySQL; ClickHouse is a plus).
  • Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
  • Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL (mandatory).
  • Airflow in production.
  • AWS experience.
  • Python proficiency.
  • Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


Nice to have

  • Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior Clickhouse experience.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Analista de BI
description:
Código da vaga: 57581


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência anterior em projetos de Governança de Dados ou BI;

- Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e documentação (BPMN);

- Forte visão analítica e habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em estruturas de dados;

- Conhecimento em gestão de metadados, glossário, linhagem e políticas de dados;

- Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo de dados (desejável: OpenMetadata);

- Conhecimento prático em SQL e Python;

- Familiaridade com ambientes AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, IAM);

- Noções de ETL/ELT e ferramentas como dbt, Airflow ou similares;

- Conhecimento em LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação;


O que será um diferencial?


- Familiaridade com DAMA DMBOK;

- Conhecimento em DataOps e automação de pipelines de dados;

- Certificações ou cursos em Governança de Dados, LGPD ou AWS;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;

  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.

title: Guidewire Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal.


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with Guidewire (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter) ;
  • Strong experience in Guidewire Configuration, Integration, and GOSU development ;
  • Solid understanding of Guidewire Studio , Product Model , and Data Model ;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level).
  • Knowledge of Java and REST/SOAP web services is desirable;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional technical and interpersonal skills;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to adapt and evolve in a fast-changing environment.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a culture focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for? Let’s chat!

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.

  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.


Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);

title: Sports Reporter
description:
Estamos buscando entusiastas do esporte que residam perto dos estados abaixo para se juntarem à nossa equipe como coletores de dados para eventos de futebol. A missão do repórter é coletar dados estatísticos ao vivo nos locais dos jogos, por meio do nosso aplicativo para dispositivos Android e iPhone.


Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês
  • Possuir um dispositivo Android/iPhone
  • Concluir um treinamento online para aprender a trabalhar com o aplicativo móvel
  • Não é necessário ter formação em jornalismo


Local de trabalho: Estádios de futebol e outros locais esportivos


Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho perfeito para estudantes ou para complementar a renda
  • Treinamento completo e gratuito
  • 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos


Estados onde precisamos urgentemente de pessoas para coleta de dados nos locais dos jogos:

  • Alagoas
  • Amazônia
  • Espírito Santo
  • Goiás
  • Maranhão
  • Mato Grosso/Mato Grosso do Sul
  • Pará
  • Paraíba
  • Piauí
  • Rondônia
